limits.coverage: All installed library sources and library lock registry packages, including unused, optional and test code; compiler executables, system libraries and exact app linkage are excluded.
limits.source_provenance: Local source/target hashes and observed compiler identity; upstream authenticity and source-to-binary provenance require separate verification.
limits.vendor_checksums: Present vendor files are checked against vendor metadata and the library lock. With --cargo-home, original archive checksums and all source hashes are also verified; vendor/archive differences remain explicit review findings. Collection never fetches inputs.
